### policy_self_consistency (this task only)
Charter-global conclusions: cite `env/env_0062_tire_and_auto_service_chain/audits/policy_task/tire_treadwear_warranty/_difficulty.md` (sections `policy_conflict_scan`, `rule_compute_equivalence`, `action_binding_and_uuids`, `prerequisite_graph`, `prerequisite_sentences`, `override_declarations`, `factor_ladders`, `findings`).

Per-task checks:
- Handling time: P1 (workmanship share) on the opening world; P0 (trial refund) after P1's replacement row. NOW = 2026-10-14.
- Real-world waits / fabricated events — FAILS (finding T1-CHAIN-1). The base event `tires_workmanship_replacement` is a physical replacement: "A tire with a manufacturing defect is replaced, free inside the free-replacement period and at the customer's prorated share after it", fields "store_id: replacing store", "odometer: odometer at replacement"; base tires_treadwear_workmanship_exclusion: "a position replaced for workmanship carries the replacement tire forward on the same set". In this world the defective RF tire has not been replaced: the 2026-10-12 inspection c52f4f0f records belt_shift and no replacement row exists; the persona only says "a technician measured the tires and told you one of them looked off inside, and that the store would sort out whatever paperwork it needed" (contrast task 0, where the persona says the store "put a new one on under warranty" and the seed carries the replacement row). The customer is returning the whole set on this call. The gold-path prerequisite write therefore books, from the phone desk, a replacement tire that was never mounted (record_workmanship_replacement_cc1528ea writes store_id "" and the inspection's odometer), and the share it books (7.60) is then paid back inside the trial refund although nothing records it was ever collected. The resolving action needs a store event that has not happened at the opening.
- Charter-global defects bearing on this task:
  - F-LABEL: `worn_measure_basis` is the only `method` factor of the workmanship share; it is a number substitution (allowance × {1, ½, 0}) — demonstrated in factor_weight.
  - F-BUNDLE: `alignment_bundle_recapture` reads the bundle with ABS(DAYS(set purchase_date, plan purchase_date)) <= 30 while the alignment charter's alignment_msr_tire_bundle counts install_date within 30 days before the plan purchase. Here install 2026-09-09 = plan purchase 2026-09-09 and purchase_price 189.99 = 219.99 − 30, so both readings agree; no scored value moves on this world.
  - O-RECAPTURE-ZERO (compute takes plan_alignments <= 1, the rule says "used only for the alignment of its purchase visit"): plan 15b6d3d8 has exactly 1 performed alignment, so no consequence here.

## findings
1. SOURCE-CHAIN RED (PLAUSIBLE) — the prerequisite's resolving write fabricates a store event (class F-CHAIN-WRK, `_difficulty.md`). Symptom: the only route to the trial refund records, from the phone desk, the replacement of the defective RF tire on a set the customer is handing back the same call. Root cause: R's sentence "The trial refund is not paid until every manufacturing defect recorded on an inspection entry of the set carries a workmanship replacement entry on the set" waits on a tires_workmanship_replacement entry, which the base charter defines as a physical replacement ("A tire with a manufacturing defect is replaced …", "store_id: replacing store", "odometer: odometer at replacement", "carries the replacement tire forward on the same set"). Evidence: inspection c52f4f0f (belt_shift) with no replacement row; persona: "told you one of them looked off inside, and that the store would sort out whatever paperwork it needed"; design_rationale "the store booked none"; the tool writes store_id "" and the inspection's odometer. Consequence: the refund rises from 756.70 to 880.30 because of a replacement that never happened — 7.60 of it returns a share nothing records as collected, 116.00 is installation refunded on the strength of that paper replacement. Affected: R rule / prerequisite, the seed (no store replacement), gold steps 14 and 16.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — mislabelled effect, workmanship share without a method factor (class F-LABEL). `worn_measure_basis` is labelled `method` but its tiers are (tread worn − a) × 100 / usable with a ∈ {2, 1, 0} (32nds) — one formula with a substituted allowance. Honestly labelled, tires_ext_workmanship_share has 5 parameter and 0 method factors (bound >= 1). Other members of the class: task 0's settleable_portion / price_paid_basis / (borderline) redemption_base_rule.
3. SOURCE-POLICY RED (charter, no value moved here) — F-RC items 1–2: W's compute picks the defect row by a priority the rule does not state and tests tier-2 timing at today rather than when the defect was found; this world has one defect row and both dates fall 1 month after purchase.
4. Observations: F-BUNDLE anchor (purchase vs install date, ABS) agrees here (install = plan purchase = 2026-09-09; purchase_price 189.99 records the discount); O-RECAPTURE-ZERO not reached (1 alignment); persona lines about the 10-12 visit and the Civic return are given only on the agent's question.
Relation to previous revisions: none (first revision).
